scope: Read-only dependency completeness review of the two actual tar.gz archives. Entry-point source was read from the archives, repository-relative helper calls and required configuration/contracts were followed, and every internally manifested file was checked for byte count and SHA-256 equality.
method: Python tarfile read-only access, in-memory manifest/hash checks, source inspection, and read-only archive SHA-256 calculation. No extraction, package generation or experiment execution was performed.

reviewedDependencyChains: prepare-labs.ps1 -> examples/MMORPG skeleton, dependencies.json, four locally copied official plugins and the engine Manny template directory manifest
Backend Build/Start/Stop/Initialize/Test-BackupRestore -> Common.ps1, migrations 001/002, Program/module rules and ThirdParty dependency configuration
Package-Lab.ps1 -> Test-ClientBoundaries.ps1, original UI/configuration, localization outputs and required externally built Unreal tools

Invoke-Smoke.ps1 and Invoke-RenderedShowcase.ps1 -> Start-Lab.ps1, Stop-Lab.ps1, backend start/stop helpers, Read-TaggedAbilityInputs.ps1, Read-TaggedAbilityDispatch.ps1, Test-MovementBaseLogs.ps1 and Test-StagedPresentation.ps1
Build-Localization.ps1 -> translate-localization.py, ui-designer-strings.json, localization-runtime-zh-Hans.json and five MMO localization INI files
prepare_content.py and native Designer builder -> ui-designer-contract.json and ui-designer-strings.json
prepare-labs.ps1 -Lab Training -> local official Lyra project plus original LyraTraining additions, without requiring the MMORPG archive
prepare_training.py -> original LyraDocTools Editor bridge and locally copied official Lyra assets
package-training.ps1 -> TrainingRange runtime verification source, descriptor and TutorialWindowsSM6.ini
verify-training-blueprints.py -> jump-event-graph.txt, dash-direction.txt and root-layout-registration.txt with explicit official source attribution
verify-training-prepare.py -> the archived original preparation script and its synchronized lab copy

boundaries.trainingFinalPackageAndRuntimeReports: Pending at review time; dependency completeness does not mark these runtime checks as passed.
boundaries.snapshotOnly: The findings apply to the exact archive SHA-256 values above. A later package refresh requires a separate current-archive check.
boundaries.selfReference: This report is external to the reviewed archives and must not be inserted into those same reviewed snapshots.
